checks/independent/ds-positive-form-cont.role: Composed scalar-positivity verification application with owned bounded integer Gram forms, exact bilinear/quadratic/event weights, invariant-preserving partitions and separately retained positivity/decoherence boundary controls
checks/independent/ds-positive-form-cont.cost: M,N1..16, at most256 owned integer feature entries; nonnegative integer scale. Every integer input, dot product term/prefix, Gram/scale result, diagonal prefix and denominator square has at most4096 bits; temporary multiplication/addition at most8192/4097 bits before admission. Bilinear/quadratic O(MN+M), Gram O(MN^2), diagonal O(MN), event O(NlogN+MN); valid coarse graining O(MN). Partition admission may inspect16 groups of16 indices before rejecting overlaps/missing coverage; valid partition has exactlyN indices and at mostN groups. Default4017 obligations =619 scalar positivity+3398 Gram/normalization controls; original648+3459=4107 loses49 duplicate nonnegative-product and61 duplicate square checks, while shared square range adds20.

groups.requirement: Own a nonempty rectangular1..16 by1..16 integer feature array and bounded nonnegative scale. Exact integer inputs exclude bool/float/Fraction/text. Admit all vector shapes/entries before projection. Bound every product/prefix and scale result, including when later cancellation or a zero scale would fit.

Compute scale*A^T*A from admitted feature columns. Bilinear values can be negative and remain successful values; quadratic values are nonnegative when computation completes. Return matrix/bilinear/quadratic queries through Outcome. All arithmetic paths retain declared intermediate budgets.

Events are owned distinct in-range indices, canonicalized increasingly; empty event has weight0. Normalize event quadratic and diagonal trace independently by the admitted positive integer denominator squared. Do not infer physical normalization or equality of global/coarse and diagonal weights. Admit denominator before dependent arithmetic even for empty events.

A partition is a nonempty ordered list of nonempty, disjoint canonical events covering every coordinate exactly once. Preserve group order and scale; group features are checked sums in canonical index order. Return a new owned Gram form. Changing within-group order cannot change resource acceptance or values.

Keep the signed off-diagonal pairing as an actual2x2 form acting on(1,-1), yielding-2t; it is separate from the positive Gram form. Nonnegative products validate both operands before multiplication, including zero/oversized combinations.

Compose both original scalar applications without importing on-load checks/global counters. Require Cases, separately count619 positivity and3398 decoherence obligations, preserve two distinct normalized witnesses(1,1)/2 and(3,4)/5, actual rank-one matrix/determinant/Gram controls and coarse global weights. Emit4017 JSON checks and nonzero expected-failure exit; propagate cancellation/programming errors.
